title: Tank 101 Thermal Runaway and Chiller Cooling Loss Mitigation

steps.instruction: Verify auxiliary chiller jacket supply flow rate Cooling_Water_Flow_PV is strictly greater than 35.0 L/min.
If chiller flow is depleted or zero, visually inspect manual butterfly isolation valve V-CH-04 at chiller heat exchanger return.
Confirm automated closure of reactant inlet valve Tank101_Inlet_Valve_Cmd to stop exothermic reactant feeding.
Engage continuous recirculation pump Tank101_Discharge_Pump_Cmd at minimum 25% flow to prevent local thermal hot-spot boundary layer buildup.
If product core temperature Tank101_Temp_PV remains above 85.0°C for > 60 seconds, notify shift supervisor and initiate emergency vessel cooling deluge.

title: Buffer Tank 101 Overfill Prevention & Headspace Pressure Recovery

steps.instruction: Cross-reference ultrasonic level transmitter Tank101_Level_PV against physical level sight glass on vessel port B.
Ensure emergency isolation solenoid Tank101_Inlet_Valve_Cmd is commanded to 0 (CLOSED).
Verify headspace pressure Tank101_Pressure_PV is below rupture disk rating (5.5 bar).
Start transfer pump Tank101_Discharge_Pump_Cmd to route excess chemical volume to secondary overflow receiver Tank-102.

title: Conveyor 201 Mechanical Jam & Drive Motor Overload Clearance

steps.instruction: Depress Conveyor 201 Stop button or local E-Stop to de-energize motor stator and prevent belt surface friction burns.
Inspect optical sensor CV201_Jam_Detect_PE1 at infeed guide rails for wedged product containers, damaged cartons, or reflective lens dust.
Perform zero-energy mechanical clearance of trapped items complying with LOTO safety protocols.
Verify drive motor phase current CV201_Motor_Current has settled below 16.5A before releasing drive restart command.
Clear inverter diagnostic register CV201_VFD_Fault_Code from the EcoStruxure HMI drive diagnostics page.

title: Control Network & Power Bus Transients Recovery

steps.instruction: Verify 24VDC auxiliary switchboard power supply bus status and check Modicon M580 rack power indicator.
Inspect Modbus TCP / Ethernet/IP switch link lights on local industrial managed switch.
Once root power or network failure is rectified, perform collective alarm acknowledge from HMI Master Screen.
